title: Play AC Online shops.json
description: Restocks and rewords a shop. The flower shop, and from api 2 Nook's (target nook: goods added to or replacing the day's roll per spot kind, every store size, from the next restock; off in the City). The game itself (not the page or the registry) refuses goods with no shelf model, money, turnips, tickets, grab bags, fossils and reserve ids, and raises a price below the item's buy-back to the buy-back. items.json lists what may be stocked. From api 2 a good may be an item of the same mod (its full id); without a price it takes the item's price. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

target.description: Which shop: "flower", or "nook" (api 2). One shop per target. A nook entry takes only mode and stock.

name.description: The shop's name on its sign: one line (no line break).

hours.description: HH:MM, open and close different. Close may be past midnight. Hours can only shorten the shop's own.

greeting.description: What the keeper says first. At most 3 line breaks.

stock_line.description: What the keeper says about the stock. At most 3 line breaks.

item.description: The item id as a string, "0x" and 4 hex digits; from api 2 also the full id of an item in this mod's items file (author.mod:thing). Listed at most once; two mod items may not share a base.

price.description: Bells. Leave out for the game's own price.

stock.description: The flower shop: 1 to 6 goods, one per table spot. Nook's: 1 to 16 goods, each in a spot of its own kind.

mode.description: Nook's only: "add" (default) puts the goods in at most half of each kind's spots, "replace" in all of them.

allOf.description: The flower shop sells at most 6 goods (one per table spot); Nook's up to 16.
